_about: Bundled supply-chain and BOM checklist of altium-copilot (run_review_checklist). Item texts are this project's own words; the topics follow the BOM and supply-chain items of Altium's PCB design review articles (resources.altium.com/p/pcb-design-review-checklist-gets-you-manufacturing-quickly). Teams change it with review_checklists.json (see README).
title: Supply chain and BOM
description: Part data, sourcing and variants of the bill of materials.
source: Topics after the BOM and supply-chain items of Altium's PCB review articles (resources.altium.com/p/pcb-design-review-checklist-gets-you-manufacturing-quickly); items written for this project.

items.text: Every fitted BOM line names a manufacturer and a manufacturer part number.

no.label: lines without a manufacturer or part number

judge.label: part numbers kept elsewhere (few parts carry one here)

items.hint: Part numbers kept in a database library are not read: say so instead of listing every part. ActiveBOM part choices count when the project has a BomDoc (get_active_bom shows them).

items.text: Parts on one BOM line agree on part number and value.

judge.label: line notes (footprints differ, lines that could merge)

items.text: No BOM text is left unresolved, and no fitted part is marked as not fitted in its text.

no.label: unresolved texts or Not Fitted markers on fitted parts

items.text: Designators are unique and every schematic part reaches the compiled BOM.

judge.label: parts outside the compiled part list

items.text: Every part is active (not end-of-life or not recommended for new designs).
Single-source parts have an approved alternate or a recorded risk.
Long-lead and low-stock parts are known and ordered in time.
Compliance data (RoHS, REACH, conflict minerals) is available for every part the product needs it for.
Every variant that ships has a BOM, a pick-and-place and an assembly drawing output set to it.
items.hint: Only variants that are built need outputs: ask which ones ship.

items.text: Variant entries still point at their parts (no stale Not Fitted or varied-parameter lines).
The BOM and the pick-and-place outputs use the same variant.

na.label: no connected BOM and pick-and-place outputs to compare

no.label: BOM and pick-and-place on different variants

items.text: The number of unique parts and placements suits the assembler.

no.label: part counts above the assembler's limits

items.hint: The limits are an assembler's: ask for its numbers (check_dfm limits=).
